title: Tuek Som Garage: Moving to the Top 10 through intensive interviews and business model selection
image1Description: Atmosphere of the business plan interview with expert judges in the Tuek Som Garage project

section1.heading: Origin and Intent
section1.content: Moving into the Top 10 of the Tuek Som Garage project was not just about presenting an interesting idea, but proving the strength of the business model and the possibility of creating a real Product. I intended to change assumptions into clear numbers and plans to show the judges that my concept could truly answer the group's business needs and was worth the investment.

section2.heading: Role and Action
section2.content: In this selection round, I played an important role as the business plan presenter (Pitcher). I had to prepare deep information in every dimension, from Target Audience analysis to revenue plans. I attended the interview in front of expert judges to answer deep questions about break-even points, risks, and business growth opportunities, until I won over the judges and successfully led my team members into the Top 10.

section3.heading: Challenges
section3.content: The highest challenge was handling the Intensive Interview, which required quick wit and sharp decision-making to answer technical and business questions in a limited time. I had to summarize raw data into powerful Key Messages and show the team's readiness to enter the Training process and real development in the next level.

section4.heading: Results and Learning
section4.content: Passing into the Top 10 was a great confirmation of my Strategic Thinking potential. This experience taught me the importance of Market Surveys and the Startup thinking process that focuses on speed but accuracy. Additionally, I received a valuable opportunity to join a Bootcamp to get training from professional speakers, which is an important foundation for developing the Product for the real market.
